correctness.rationale: A self-contained proof establishes the ruler-position formula, exact occurrences of each smaller Zimin block, all possible continuations of each proper prefix, and the complete border set. Inserting the unique highest-ranked letter produces exactly three exhaustive cases: old absent words persist, words with two new letters must have them as endpoints around a Zimin border, and words with one new letter must use an alternative continuation of a Zimin prefix. Disjoint explicit templates then give 1+(n-m-1)^2 words of length 2^m+1 and the cubic total. The independently generated complete absent-word oracle and all prefix-continuation sets match ranks 1 through 9. This finite check supplements rather than substitutes for induction.

value.rationale: The problem asks for the canonical anti-dictionary of a heavily nested, exponentially long family central to unavoidable-pattern theory. The result gives all forbidden templates with a rank-index triple, identifies a nontrivial lacunary length spectrum, exact per-level multiplicities and total Θ(n^3) obstruction count relative to host length 2^n−1. This is a motivated compact classification relevant to finite factor-language representation and a specific structural property not supplied by generic enumeration.
